name: rules_test
description: Realtime Database security rules tests (run against the RTDB emulator).

scripts.test:unit: ./support/isolated.sh env NODE_OPTIONS=--import=./support/no_production.mjs node --test --test-concurrency=1 os_boundary.test.mjs safety.test.mjs allowlist.test.mjs audit_identity.test.mjs verify_admin.test.mjs deploy_scripts.test.mjs deploy_functions.test.mjs
scripts.test:live: ./support/isolated.sh firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database --project demo-dau-rules "NODE_OPTIONS=--import=./support/no_production.mjs node --test live_cli.test.mjs"
scripts.test:dart: ./support/isolated.sh firebase emulators:exec --only database --project demo-dau-rules "cd dart_spike && dart run bin/cas_spike.dart && dart run bin/identity_protocol_spike.dart"
